defaultLead: Two exclusive-use options: spaces only for days and shoots, or the whole estate with bungalow lodging for retreats and overnight events.
pricingNote: * Price on request according to dates, guests and services. Dining, set-up and high season may vary. Catering with Azurea is quoted separately. *

whatsapp.intro: Hello, I would like a quote for: {title}.

finca-espacios.title: Whole estate — spaces only
finca-espacios.subtitle: Exclusive use without bungalow lodging
finca-espacios.description: Book the entire estate for your event, company day or shoot: gardens, porch, pool (in season), library lounge, country kitchens and outdoor areas. Ideal when your guests do not stay overnight at Los Collados.
includes: Exclusive use of indoor and outdoor spaces
Complete privacy of the estate for the day

finca-completa.title: Whole estate — with lodging
finca-completa.subtitle: Exclusive use + 8 bungalows (16 adults)
finca-completa.description: The estate fully reserved for your group: an event or retreat with overnight stay in the 8 bungalows. Perfect for company retreats, family celebrations with guests sleeping on the estate, or productions lasting several days.
includes: 8 bungalows (up to 16 adults + children according to booking)
Exclusive use of the whole estate and event spaces
Up to 50 people outdoors / 30 indoors for the event

finca-fin-semana.title: Whole estate — weekend
finca-fin-semana.subtitle: Friday to Sunday · exclusive use and lodging
finca-fin-semana.description: Reserve the entire estate from Friday to Sunday: a celebration, event or retreat with overnight stay in the 8 bungalows and private use of gardens, porch, pool (in season) and rooms throughout the weekend.
includes: Exclusive use of the estate throughout the weekend
Up to 50 people outdoors / 30 indoors for the event
Indoor and outdoor spaces not shared with other guests
capacity: Lodging: up to 16 adults (+ children according to booking)

pricing.weekday: Includes lodging and exclusive use of spaces
pricing.weekend: Dining and set-up with Azurea Catering quoted separately

idealFor: Communions and birthdays with overnight stay

sesiones-fotograficas.title: Content creation for companies
sesiones-fotograficas.subtitle: Hire by the hour on the estate
sesiones-fotograficas.description: Hourly hire of the estate for photo sessions, fashion or product shootings, content recording and filming. Indoor and outdoor settings with complete privacy and multiple locations in a single place.
includes: Hourly hire of agreed spaces (indoor and/or outdoor)
Gardens, porch, library lounge and rural areas of the estate
Basic logistical support from the estate team
capacity: Minimum and duration according to type of session or shoot
No overnight stay in bungalows (unless booked separately)

pricing.halfDay: Hourly blocks, half day or full day
pricing.weekday: Personalised quote after enquiry on dates and spaces
pricing.priceNote: * We assess each project individually. In some cases we can look at a collaboration or exchange; that is why the price is quoted once we know your proposal.
